name: Stand
overview: Scripture calls believers to stand firm in the liberty Christ has provided, resisting the bondage of sin and the schemes of the devil by putting on the full armor of God. This steadfastness is rooted in courage and confidence that the Lord is with His people wherever they go, empowering them to resist conformity to the world through the renewing of the mind. Patience and perseverance are essential in maintaining one's soul, grounded in the truth that Jesus is the exclusive way to the Father.
